subject: Short notice: CIO handoff & recording preference for Atherix pilot demo

Cc: devon.lee@atherix.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask: CIO attendance for pilot demo on 9/29 + recording preference

Hi Olga and Ben,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. We're lining up the pilot for Sept 29 and I wanted to confirm a couple of exec-level items before I lock the calendar:

- Can your team confirm whether the CIO (Thomas Keller) will be present for the demo? He's currently considering attending for the first 20 minutes to hear the architecture/controls discussion.
- If the CIO joins, would Redwood record the session? We have an internal policy asking whether demos with execs can be recorded and who will retain the recording.

We're trying to avoid multiple reschedules on short notice — if there's any travel conflict we can set a delegate. If needed, procurement will also need a shorter mutual action plan after the demo.

Appreciate a quick note so I can finalize invites.

Best,
Samantha Cho
Head of Product Programs | Atherix
Samantha.cho@atherix.com

Samantha —

Thanks for the heads up. Short answers up front: we expect the CIO to join for the opening ~15–20 minutes but he may need to jump for a travel call; we can record the session but want to confirm Atherix's retention/usage policy.

Proposed plan:
- 30-min technical kickoff with CIO present for first 15 (architecture & security highlights).
- If CIO needs to depart, Ben will run the remainder of the demo and capture the Q&A notes.
- We will record the full session and provide a trimmed version (first 15 min labeled "Exec highlights") if you prefer; Redwood will store the recording in our secure S3 with access controlled to the Atherix contacts you provide.

Action items for you: confirm (a) CIO will at least join briefly, (b) whether Atherix wants the full recording, a trimmed exec clip only, or no recording retained.

Attaching the current pilot agenda and our demo runbook for your review.

Olga Petrov

Our preference: please record the full session for internal review but do NOT distribute the exec-first-15 clip beyond the named Atherix execs. Redwood is fine to host the recording; procurement and legal will request retention details post-demo.

Also: is it possible to nudge the demo start time 30 minutes earlier on the 29th? That would help Thomas avoid the overlap. If a move isn't possible, he'll drop in and handoff to Devon (me) for the rest.
